title: Chauffeur company asks for a person
persona: Dwayne Pierce, runs a corporate chauffeur fleet in Dallas. Businesslike, direct, wants a human.
goal: Get a person on the line, and see what the agent does with a limo operator who asks for a human.
opening_line: I run a chauffeur company, corporate clients. Can I talk to somebody on your team?

turns.caller: I don't want a demo, I want to talk to a person about my fleet.
Do you have anything for limo companies in particular?

branches.if_agent: agent mentions the AI Chauffeur demo
branches.caller: Oh. So that's a demo, not a person?

turns.caller: What would it cost me if I go ahead?
I have forty vehicles. Is there a fleet discount?
Alright. Can I try the demo first and then talk to the team?
Yeah, do that. Transfer me to the demo.

curveballs: Wants both the demo and the team
expected: Honors the request for a person by describing the team path
Still offers the AI Chauffeur demo as the agent built for limo operators
Does not invent a fleet discount
Transfers to the demo when he agrees
must_not: Refuse or ignore the request for a person
Invent a fleet discount or promise
Call anyone the owner or name a specific person on the team
